android.desc:
Connect is a native Android app for browsing the social platform Lemmy and Piefed.

Connect highlights:
- Completely free. 100% access to all functionality with zero ads or tracking.
- Easy to understand. No understanding of federation or ActivityPub required
- Fast. A native application that loads quickly and isn't heavy
- Clean UI. No ads, Material v3 everything.

Features:
- Full Piefed support, the only Android app to support all Piefed functionality
- Offline mode, browse even when offline and on the go
- Cloud sync, keep your settings safe
- Alerts, get notified when your favourite community has a new post
- User Notes, History, Deep customization support, Themes, and more!

Hi, I started this project after leaving Reddit and being dissatisfied with the current Lemmy apps. I wanted a browsing experience similar to what I was used to and I hope others who are in a similar situation will enjoy Connect.
